trust_decision.summary: An untrusted admin search string 'q' is scanned by an unanchored filter regex (\w+):(...) in separate_filters_from_query; with no length cap, finditer/sub backtrack quadratically on long word runs. The fix adds a leading \b and precompiles the pattern.

landing_point.why: The advisory names 'search query parsing'. The only filter regex sits in separate_filters_from_query, which parse_query_string calls.

fix_sites.entry_point: GET admin /pages/search/ and /pages/search/results/ ?q= -> page_filter_search -> parse_query_string (wagtail/admin/views/pages/search.py:30); also public API wagtail.search.utils.parse_query_string/separate_filters_from_query
same: re.sub with the same pattern in separate_filters_from_query

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No real candidate. The bulk-action route (wagtail/admin/views/pages/bulk_actions/page_bulk_action.py:35) goes through the same page_filter_search -> parse_query_string, so the single regex fix covers it automatically.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Filters like 'live:true' and quoted values (author:"foo bar", author:'foo bar') must keep parsing. A fix that truncates q or drops filter parsing breaks the admin 'live:'/'published:' filter.

O6_input_shapes: long unbroken word run with no colon ("0"*60000)
long key before a quoted value
chained filters foo:bar:baz (the \b changes the remainder)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second filter/term regex in normalise_query_string-style helpers used by search promotions/query logging
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: normalise_query_string already runs a regex on user query strings for Query/promotions (wagtail/search/models.py:80, wagtail/contrib/search_promotions/views.py:277), but it truncates first. That makes a planted untruncated variant plausible, though it is a where-type sibling.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sanitising regex over the raw phrase in a backend query compiler
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Backends already regex-scrub user input here (currently a linear \W+), so a backtracking variant would read naturally. It sits in another package from the landing point.

O9_family: ReDoS (CWE-1333) / polynomial regex backtracking in a query parser

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Truncate q to MAX_QUERY_STRING_LENGTH in page_filter_search or parse_query_string. It is effective but leaves the public utility API unbounded.

out_of_scope_notes: Every regex on user search input in wagtail/search/backends is linear \W+ (wagtail/search/backends/database/mysql/query.py:58, :156); no other copy of the (\w+): idiom exists in wagtail/**/*.py.
unverified: The three fix commits carry an identical utils.py hunk (main plus backports); which one targets this 5.2.x pinned tree was not confirmed. The diff's new tests (test_long_queries, test_joined_filters, test_long_filter_value) are absent at the pinned commit.
Whether non-admin frontend search views call parse_query_string: a repo grep found only wagtail/admin/views/pages/search.py:30 and tests.
